preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The number of integers N in each test case must be between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each integer in the array A must be between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: If no valid permutations exist, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by two lines of N integers each.

postconditions.expression: any(B[i:j] != C[i:j] for i in range(1, N) for j in range(i, N) if (i, j) != (1, N))
postconditions.description: If valid permutations B and C exist, ensure no subarray B[i:j] is a permutation of C[i:j] for any valid i and j.
